meta.unit_note: per-micro series divide EACH round trip by its OWN contract quantity (trip net / ($1.25 x trip_micros)), not by one assumed size: 29 trials and C-H4 code 1 micro, D-H2 and RT7 size 1..5 micros by rule. The per_trade/per_day *_ticks_per_micro fields are the superseded flat-$2.50 figures, kept for comparison.
